whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Hotel Picnic Garden,

I noticed your hotel has an incredible 3.9★ rating with over 2,200 reviews in Bihta, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking website for rooms, events, and dining inquiries.

Maine aapke hotel ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp booking, room/dining showcase, aur map directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/picnicgarden

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Hotel Picnic Garden team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with mobile-first speed, direct WhatsApp room booking, and a showcase of your property on the Bihta Main Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact services, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
